content: Cerebellar Disorders On this page Basics Summary Start Here Diagnosis and Tests Learn More Specifics Genetics See, Play and Learn Videos and Tutorials Research Clinical Trials Journal Articles Resources Find an Expert For You Patient Handouts Summary When you play the piano or hit a tennis ball you are activating the cerebellum. The cerebellum is the area of the brain that controls coordination and balance. Problems with the cerebellum include: Cancer Genetic disorders Ataxias - failure of muscle control in the arms and legs that result in movement disorders Degeneration - disorders caused by brain cells decreasing in size or wasting away Treatment of cerebellar disorders depends on the cause. In some cases, there is no cure but treatment may help with symptoms.
